actions.NO_DECISION: Do not issue a model-based decision; inspect data quality or feature readiness.
actions.MONITOR: Continue routine monitoring; no automated regulatory action.
actions.WATCH: Place on analyst watchlist and review recent KPI trends.
actions.REVIEW: Analyst review recommended; inspect affected KPIs, geography and supporting evidence.
actions.HIGH_REVIEW: Priority analyst review recommended; validate against source data before any regulatory or operational action.
